caption: A drone hovers over a sunlit parking lot and then flies to one side, and its small shadow on the asphalt moves with it.

sa.check: A drone hovers over a parking lot.
Its shadow on the asphalt moves with it.
The drone moves first and the shadow follows.

pc.expect: The shadow stays beneath the drone, offset away from the sun, and moves when the drone moves.
pc.fail: It stays still while the drone flies; or moves the opposite way; or lies toward the sun.

pc.expect: The shadow shows the drone's arms and body.
pc.fail: It is a plain blob unlike the drone; or a different shape; or it splits.

pc.expect: The shadow does not move on its own.
pc.fail: It moves with the drone hovering still; or it drifts across the asphalt by itself.

pc.expect: The shadow lies on the ground; the drone stays in the air while its rotors run.
pc.fail: The shadow rises off the ground; or the drone drops with the rotors running; or it climbs while descending.
A second drone or shadow appears; or the drone vanishes; or the shadow becomes solid; or an arm detaches.

pc.expect: The drone's colour and the lot stay the same, and the shadow stays dark.
pc.fail: The drone changes colour; or the shadow turns coloured; or the lot markings shift.
